scope: Memory-only recovery contract, native restore control-generation fence and recovered AITD reuse guidance; no public Python recovery operation

contract.revert: Restore compatible emulator memory and machine/device state, never older host file contents
contract.mutable_closed_saves: Current disk versions survive; a changed closed autosave alone must not block recovery
contract.current_io: Flushing current buffered writes is not historical disk rollback; the first recovery profile still needs explicit DOS handle/device qualification
contract.load_admission: Raw state.load requires expected_generation; preserve owner and consume generation before cleanup and serializer effects
contract.failure: Stale generation is rejected before effects; an admitted failure cannot revive the old generation
contract.input_reset: Pre-load cleanup only; does not prove neutral restored device input
